TP-Link TL-WN722N Detailed Specifications

  • Hardware Interface: USB 2.0.

  • Wireless Standards: IEEE 802.11n, IEEE 802.11g, IEEE 802.11b (Wi-Fi 4).

  • Frequency Band: 2.4 GHz (2.400 - 2.4835GHz).

  • Maximum Signal Rate: Up to 150 Mbps (Dynamic).

  • Antenna Type: 1x Detachable Omni-Directional Antenna.
